'''Unit 3''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] of [[Lance Squadron (Revanites)|Lance Squadron]], a military unit of the [[Order of Revan]]. Unit 3 and Lance Squadron were deployed during the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|Battle of Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
